about.title: About YojanaSetu and Legal Disclaimer
about.subtitle: Empowering citizens across India to access entitlements through transparent technology.
about.missionText: Millions of eligible citizens miss out on government welfare benefits due to fragmented information, complicated eligibility criteria, and lack of clear guidance. YojanaSetu ('Scheme Bridge') was built as an independent, transparent bridge connecting citizens directly to official schemes.
about.independenceText: YojanaSetu is an independent project and is NOT affiliated with, sponsored by, or an official website of the Government of India or any state government. Official applications must always be completed on respective government portals ending in .gov.in or .nic.in.
about.accuracyText: All scheme criteria and summaries on YojanaSetu are cross-referenced against published government gazettes, guidelines, and portal documentation. However, government policies and budget allotments change periodically. Always verify with official authorities before applying.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your privacy is our foundational principle. We do not track, collect, or store personal identifiers.
privacy.noPiiText: We never ask for, collect, or store Aadhaar numbers, PAN cards, voter IDs, phone numbers, email addresses, names, or bank account details. Any temporary input provided during an eligibility check is processed solely in transient browser memory.
privacy.storageText: We only save your accessibility and interface preferences (selected language, text size preference, and high contrast toggle) in your browser's local storage. Your user queries and eligibility profiles are never saved to local storage or transmitted to analytics services.
privacy.cookiesText: YojanaSetu uses no commercial tracking cookies, no third-party behavioral pixels, and no fingerprinting technologies.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Conditions of use for the YojanaSetu citizen portal.
terms.infoText: YojanaSetu is an informational directory and eligibility guidance tool. It does not disburse funds, grant approvals, or accept government applications. Submission of welfare applications must be done through sanctioned government offices or websites.
terms.liabilityText: While we strive for absolute accuracy based on official government documentation, YojanaSetu and its contributors are not liable for any discrepancies, policy changes, rejected applications, or outcomes resulting from use of this information.
terms.redirectText: Links leading to external government websites (.gov.in, .nic.in) are provided for convenience. We do not control or endorse external third-party software.
